question: ______scheme aims to provide measures for Comprehensive Rehabilitation for Welfare of Transgender Persons.

options.text: Support for Marginalised Individuals for Livelihood and Education
Scheme for Medium Individuals for Livelihood and Enterprise
Support for Marginalised Individuals for Livelihood and Enterprise
Support for Marginalised Individuals for Livelihood and Entity

solution:
The correct answer is __**Support for Marginalised Individuals for Livelihood and Enterprise**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

**Support for Marginalised Individuals for Livelihood and Enterprise:-**

 
• SMILE is an umbrella scheme launched by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India, in February 2022.
 
• **The scheme aims to provide comprehensive rehabilitation and support to marginalized individuals, including transgender persons and persons engaged in the act of begging, to enable them to live dignified and productive lives.**
 
• The SMILE scheme provides a range of benefits, including:
 
 
• **Skill development training **to help marginalized individuals acquire the skills they need to get jobs or start their own businesses.
 
• **Seed capital assistance **to help marginalized individuals start their own businesses or expand their existing businesses.
 
• **Placement assistance **to help marginalized individuals find jobs in the formal or informal sector.
 
• **Social security benefits**, such as old age pension, disability pension, and widow pension, to marginalized individuals who are eligible.
